Name: Common Crow - Corvus brachyrhynchos
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Woodlands, farm lands, river groves and shores. Wherever food may be found.
Foods: Omniverous, grasshopper, scarab bettles, carrion, ground beetles, caterpillars, crustaceans, amphibians, reptiles, corn, wheat and sunflower.
Miscellaneous: May be destructive to crops and other bird populations.
Name: Pinyon Jay - Gymnorhinus cyanocephala
Habitat: Found in or near pinon pines, jumpers or sage. Build nests in colony.
Foods: Insects, pinon and pine seeds, wheat, corn and barley. Miscellaneous: Large numbers of these birds feed together.
Name: Clark Nutcracker - Nucifraga columbiana
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Found in mountainous areas.
Foods: Rice seeds are major diet, also insects, wheat, corn barley and oats.
Name: Black-capped Chickadee - Parus atricapillus
Montana resedent in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Mixed woodlands, willow groves. Nest in cavity of tree of stump.
Foods: Primarily use animal foods. Eggs of insects and spiders, insects, spiders, pine, poison ivy, sunflower, and ragweed.
Name: Nuthatches - Family Sittidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fail, winter.
Habitat: Conifer forests, mixed forests, river groves and brushy areas.

Nest in tree cavity.
Foods: Beetles, weevils, ants, spiders, moths, caterpillars also pine, wheat and oats.
Name: Brown Creeper - Certhia familiaris
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall.
Habitat: Forest groves. Nest behind loose bark.
Foods: Insects and spiders found on trees, some pine and corn.
Name: Dipper (water suzel) - Cindus mexicanus
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Near water, usually fast flowing stream. Construct nest of moss along stream bank.
Foods: Mainly aquatic insects, snails, moths, fish eggs and small fish.
Miscellaneous: Able to walk on bottom of fast flowing stream in search of food.
Name: Wrens - Family Troglodytidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall.
